turns.content: Habari, nataka kununua viatu viwili na tisheti moja
Habari! Tuna viatu vyema na tisheti. Viatu ni KES 3,000 kila jozi, tisheti KES 1,200. Unataka viatu vya rangi gani na saizi gani?
Viatu nyeusi saizi 42, tisheti nyeusi saizi L
Sawa! 2x Viatu Nyeusi Saizi 42 = KES 6,000. 1x Tisheti Nyeusi Saizi L = KES 1,200. Jumla KES 7,200. Wapi unataka kuitwa?
Westlands ni KES 150. Jumla KES 7,350. Thibitisha oda?
